wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-001 wires the WAD header parse, directory parse, lump-name lookup, and game-mode identification into a single typed IwadResourceCache. The read-only refs (src/wad/ and src/assets/) supply the building blocks; the cache itself lives at src/vanilla/iwadResourceCache.ts and consumes a LaunchContext (from 03-004) plus a caller-supplied IwadFileLoader so the cache is deterministic under test. Failure modes (empty buffer, missing file, parse failure, non-IWAD header) surface as typed IwadResourceCacheError instances with a stable IwadResourceCacheErrorReason discriminator. The cache calls identifyGame against the resolved IWAD basename and the lump lookup, so the final GameIdentification reconciles the filename-derived gameMode with the actual lump contents (Ultimate vs Registered vs Shareware vs Commercial vs Chex).
publicSurface: IwadResourceCache interface (gameIdentification, header, directory, lookup, findLump, getAllIndicesForName, hasLump)
IwadResourceCacheError extends Error (reason: IwadResourceCacheErrorReason, resolvedPath: string)
